display_title: HORIZON-CL5-2027-01-D1-07 Advancing understanding, modelling and prediction of extreme events in a changing climate – Horizon Europe
call_module_title: HORIZON-CL5-2027-01-D1-07 Advancing understanding, modelling and prediction of extreme events in a changing climate
executive_summary: This Research and Innovation Action supports modelling and prediction of extreme, compound and cascading climate events and their infrastructure impacts. Projects use observations and a hierarchy of models. Eligible research consortia can include infrastructure operators with a substantive case-study role. The topic budget is EUR 18 million with around EUR 6 million expected per project. It opens 2026-11-17 and closes 2027-03-04 at 17:00 Brussels time.
status_rationale: Climate, Energy and Mobility Work Programme, pp. 66–68, Specific conditions and Scope, defines the work. An eligible Dutch TSO can contribute project-funded infrastructure observations and operational expertise to a consortium modelling compound or cascading events affecting critical systems. The connection to Digital Twin Programme supports Type 1 and C1.3. The date helper provides both project dates as defaults from 1 January 2027 and 36 months.
